description:
Description
A beautiful villa with 8 bedrooms, 5 balconies,  Dining hall, Reception Room and two kitchen commercial.

Located right opposite the Kerala Raj Bhavan (official residence of the Governor of Kerala), Avenue Kowdiar is on the stately 2-km long tree-lined Kawdiar Avenue with the fabled Kowdiar Palace (home of the Royal Family of Travancore) at one end and the official residence of the Arch Bishop of Trivandrum at the other end. In between you will find winsome architectural marvels including Manmohan Bunglaw (once the residence of the Dewan of Travancore) and the Belhaven Palace. Within walkable distance in one of the beautiful walkways in the country are Kerala's most prestigious clubs (Golf Club, Tennis Club, Trivandrum Club, Sri Mulam Club) as well the State Museum, Kanakakunnu Palace, the State Zoo etc. The International Airport is 15 minutes away as is Sri Padbhanabhaswamy Temple. The well-known beach destination, Kovalam, is 30 minutes away.

8 bedrooms  are air conditioned . Spacious dining room, Reception and office rooms. 10toilets each with modern amenities. Ideal for high end guest house. Can park upto 5 cars

We are letting out the whole villa except the Pent house and an office room. Sepate entrance for both

Prime Location: Nestled Between Kowdiar & Pattom | Super Built-Up Area: 2,000 Sq. Ft. | Configuration: 3 Bedrooms + 1 Study Room + 4 Attached Bathrooms
An Overview of Elegance and Comfort

Welcome to a lifestyle of unmatched sophistication. Situated in one of Thiruvananthapuram’s most prestigious and sought-after residential corridors—right near the elite hubs of Kowdiar and Pattom—this expansive 2,000 sq. ft. residence has been thoughtfully crafted to meet the highest standards of modern urban living.

Whether you are looking to upgrade your family's living standards or secure a high-value property in a prime location, this home delivers an exceptional blend of architectural finesse, privacy, and state-of-the-art conveniences.
Detailed Interior Highlights

    Expansive Living & Dining Zones: Step into a remarkably bright and airy open-plan living and dining area designed to seamlessly accommodate family gatherings and formal hosting.

    3 Generous Bedrooms: Each bedroom serves as a private retreat, offering ample space for large beds, wardrobes, and personalized decor while ensuring optimal cross-ventilation.

    Dedicated Study Room: Complete with an additional, versatile Study Room—perfect for a professional home office, a quiet reading library, or an interactive homeschooling space for children.

    4 Attached Bathrooms: Absolute privacy is guaranteed with all 4 rooms (the 3 bedrooms plus the study) featuring contemporary, fully fitted attached bathrooms equipped with high-end sanitaryware and premium fixtures.

    Centralised AC: Enjoy absolute climate control throughout the entire home with a professionally installed Centralised AC system, ensuring a crisp and comfortable atmosphere regardless of the weather outside.

    Reticulated Gas Piping: The kitchen is integrated with a safe, modern Reticulated Gas supply line, eliminating the hassle of heavy cylinder replacements and ensuring a streamlined cooking experience.

    Attractive Balconies: Step out onto stylish, well-proportioned balconies that offer panoramic neighborhood views, excellent morning sunlight, and a peaceful spot to unwind with a cup of tea.


    State-of-the-Art Gym: Maintain your health and wellness goals right inside the community premises with a fully equipped, modern fitness center.

    Rejuvenating Swimming Pool: Dive into a sparkling pool designed for leisure, weekend relaxation, and aquatic fitness.

    Covered Car Parking: Your vehicle stays protected and secure in a designated, easily accessible covered parking bay.

    Community Security: Multi-tier 24/7 security surveillance, intercom facilities, and dedicated maintenance staff ensure a safe and peaceful environment for your family.


Living near Kowdiar and Pattom places you at the epicenter of Trivandrum’s finest social infrastructure.

    Education: Minutes away from top-tier schools and educational institutions.

    Healthcare: Close proximity to multi-specialty hospitals and pharmacies.

    Lifestyle & Leisure: Easy access to premium supermarkets, fine-dining restaurants, clubs, and cultural centers.

    Connectivity: Smooth, hassle-free commuting routes connecting you to major business districts, the railway station, and the airport.
